<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>MonadicSharp.Agents</id>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <authors>Danny4897</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Danny4897/MonadicSharp.Framework</projectUrl>
    <description>Typed multi-agent orchestration for .NET — capability-based sandboxing, railway-oriented pipelines, circuit breakers, and immutable audit trails. Build secure, composable AI agent systems with compile-time guarantees.</description>

    <tags>ai agents orchestration multi-agent capability-security railway-oriented-programming result circuit-breaker pipeline monadic</tags>

    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions" version="8.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" version="8.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MonadicSharp" version="1.4.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MonadicSharp.AI" version="1.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
